claim: Compute actual-temperature monochromatic atomic absorption rather than claim an unsupported TOPS interpolation certificate. Inspect and bind public SYNSPEC source, then connect the same EOS particle inventory and couple the computed spectrum.
decision: Identify direct-temperature opacity and population injection boundary before any production or stellar evolution.
limits: Independent atomic model and incomplete line/population matches must be explicit. Do not substitute running the code for EOS/opacity physical certification. No full production until source flow, pilot speed, precision and acceptance gates are established.
